X 早报 · 2026-11-02（周一）

概览

过去 24 小时的时间线以美股与宏观为主：本周将迎来苹果、Palantir、AMD 等财报以及周二的美国中期选举，S&P 500 上周五下跌 1.8%，等权指数 10 月大幅跑赢、黄金 ETF 流出、铜市场极度紧张。AI 资本开支继续创纪录，四大云厂商 Q3 CapEx 达 2019 亿美元，围绕 AI 资金缺口、算力过剩（B300 租价下跌）与 OpenAI 融资缩水的讨论升温。苹果方面，Mark Gurman 披露触屏 MacBook Pro、M7 芯片及 2027 年 iPad 更新计划。地缘政治上，Axios 报道内塔尼亚胡敦促特朗普在中期选举后打击伊朗；加密圈则在讨论 FBI 点名朝鲜 TraderTraitor 为 63 亿美元币安被盗案幕后黑手。此外还有万圣节、个人品牌与 AI 创作者经验等轻松话题。

宏观与市场

The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)

本周要事：
1. 10 月 ISM 制造业 PMI 数据——周一
2. 苹果（$AAPL）和 Palantir（$PLTR）发布财报——周一
3. 美国中期选举——周二
4. 9 月 JOLTS 职位空缺数据——周二
5. AMD（$AMD）和 SMCI（$SMCI）发布财报——周二
6. 10 月 ADP 非农就业人数变化——周三
7. 10 月 ISM 非制造业 PMI 数据——周三
8. 10 月非农就业报告——周五
9. 11 月密歇根大学通胀预期与消费者信心数据——周五
10. 本周约 20% 的标普 500 成分公司发布财报
11. 本周共有 5 场美联储官员讲话
系好安全带，重磅一周即将到来。

市场领涨板块正在迅速切换。

原文：BREAKING: The S&P 500 Equal-Weight Index outperformed the S&P 500 by +5.7 percentage points in October, its largest monthly outperformance since April 2009.
This also marked its 2nd-largest monthly outperformance since the 1990s.
The Equal-Weight Index surged +4.8% in October, while the S&P 500 fell -0.9%.
Year-to-date, the Equal-Weight Index has gained +13.9%, exceeding the S&P 500's +10.7% return as technology stocks lag the broader market.
Meanwhile, the S&P 500 ex-AI Index has jumped +14.2% year-to-date, reaching a new all-time high on Friday.
Market leadership is rapidly shifting.

突发：9 月美国商品贸易逆差扩大 28 亿美元（2.1%），至 1349 亿美元，为 2025 年 3 月以来最大。
进口增加 81 亿美元（2.4%），达到创纪录的 3442 亿美元。
此次增长主要由资本品环比增长 7.5% 带动，其中包括为 AI 建设提供动力的计算机及配件、半导体和电信设备。
目前，资本品逆差同比扩大 543 亿美元，超过了整体贸易逆差的全部增幅。
与此同时，9 月美国商品出口增加 53 亿美元（2.6%），至 2092 亿美元，主要受食品出口增长 12.8% 推动。
美国贸易逆差正再次迅速扩大。

原文：BREAKING: The US goods trade deficit widened by -$2.8 billion in September, or -2.1%, to -$134.9 billion, its widest gap since March 2025.
Imports rose +$8.1 billion, or +2.4%, to a record $344.2 billion.
This jump was led by a +7.5% MoM increase in capital goods, which include computers and accessories, semiconductors, and telecommunications equipment fueling the AI buildout.
Now, the capital goods deficit has widened by -$54.3 billion YoY, accounting for more than the entire increase in the overall trade deficit.
Meanwhile, US goods exports jumped +$5.3 billion in September, or +2.6%, to $209.2 billion, driven by a +12.8% increase in food shipments.
The US trade deficit is rapidly widening again.

全球铜市场极度紧张：
中国铜进口相对伦敦金属交易所（LME）价格的溢价已超过每吨 200 美元，创有记录以来最高。
洋山溢价（以上海一座中国铜进口主要枢纽港口命名）在过去 3 个月内翻了一倍多。
自 2026 年初以来，这一数字已飙升 700%。
此外，LME 现货相对三个月期货的升水扩大至每吨 217 美元，为 8 月中旬以来最高。
这主要源于中国强劲的铜需求，以及国内库存低于往年同期的季节性水平。
与此同时，市场预期美国可能对精炼铜加征关税，已使数十万吨铜转运至美国，导致全球库存高度集中在美国。
实物铜的供应紧张远未结束。

原文：The global copper market is extremely tight:
China's copper import premium over London Metal Exchange (LME) prices has surpassed $200 per ton, the largest premium on record.
The Yangshan premium, named after a Shanghai port that serves as a major hub for Chinese copper imports, has more than doubled over the last 3 months.
Since the beginning of 2026, this figure has surged +700%.
Furthermore, the premium of spot prices over three-month futures on the LME widened to $217 per ton, the largest since mid-August.
This has been driven by strong Chinese copper demand and domestic inventories falling below typical seasonal levels.
At the same time, expectations of potential US tariffs on refined copper have redirected hundreds of thousands of tons of copper to the US, leaving global inventories heavily concentrated in the country.
The physical copper supply squeeze is far from over.

$SPY 的月度 BX 趋势指标刚刚收红。
70% 的情况下这意味着回调，30% 的情况下意味着崩盘。
以下是我对后市演变的看法。
我们已经正式跌破日线级别 758 美元的波段低点，这并不理想。过去几周我们一直在关注这个区域，它是一个非常重要的短期价位。
价格有可能从这里反弹，并比我预期的更早冲回历史高点。但从历史来看，这种情况只有约 20% 到 25% 的概率，所以我不指望它。
既然支撑已经跌破，如果价格在未来一周内无法重新站上 760 美元，很可能会继续向下派发至 740 美元，也就是日线级别较低的聪明钱区域。
我现在最担心的是月度 BX 趋势指标收红了。
切换到月线图你会发现，在过去十年中，月度 BX 趋势指标转红并不一定意味着市场全面崩盘。（图 2）
通常，它意味着从当前位置继续回调约 5%。
幅度最大的一次回调是 2022 年 1 月至 2022 年 10 月，市场进入了长达数月的全面熊市，之后才找到潜在底部。在此之前是 2020 年，市场因新冠疫情下跌约 26%；以及 2018 年的一次调整，跌幅约 12%。
所以回顾过去十年，月度 BX 趋势指标转红并不一定意味着市场会崩盘，但它往往意味着整体买盘力量正在被抽离。
最近两次出现这种情况是在 2026 年 3 月和 2025 年 4 月。两次都出现了约一个月的持续抛售，随后是 V 型反弹。
这并不意味着我们需要恐慌。但正如我在分析开头所说，继续回调 2% 到 3% 是很有可能的。
再回看之前的十年，即 2000 年到 2011 年，月度 BX 出现过多次翻转。（图 3）
大多数时候，比如 2005 年和 2006 年，价格只是继续稳步上涨。但那十年里发生过三次大幅回调。第一次是互联网泡沫，月度 BX 转红后市场下跌约 44%。然后是 2008 年金融危机，月度 BX 转红后市场下跌约 53%。
我不希望你担心。月度 BX 转红并不意味着市场会崩盘，只有约 30% 的情况下才会如此。
我们需要明白的是，如果市场要崩盘，那一定会发生在月度 BX 趋势指标为红色的时候。所以当 BX 趋势指标为红色时，我们需要比牛市周期中更加谨慎。
这并不意味着我们要改变交易方式。我们仍然专注于聪明钱区域，仍然专注于高质量的交易机会。但没有理由过度加杠杆或大举买入看涨期权。出现这种情况时，我的计划中会提高谨慎程度。
说了这么多，我们现在处于什么位置？
最重要的是要记住，结构比周期或月度 BX 更重要。在我们讨论过的每一个月度 BX 转红后市场反弹的案例中，结构都守住了；而在每一个市场陷入严重下跌的案例中，结构都失守了。所以只要结构守住，我认为标普 500 出现 10% 到 15% 大幅调整的可能性很低。
目前在日线图上，很有可能再回调 2% 至 740 美元左右。那将是一个强劲的短期区域，通常也是价格反弹的位置。如果你使用周线级别的 33 公允价值带，那里也是一个主要支撑。
如果跌破 728 美元，就会进入严重调整区间。届时，我会预期价格抛售至 684 美元到 660 美元的周线机构买入区，聪明钱区域位于 660 美元到 650 美元之间。这将回补 2026 年 4 月留下的下方缺口。
正如我所说，我暂时不会担心这一点，因为所有较小时间周期上的结构依然完好。如果较小时间周期开始失守，那时我们才需要意识到可能出现更大范围的调整。

原文：$SPY’s monthly BX trender just closed red.
70% of the time that means a dip. 30% of the time it means a crash.
Here’s how I see things playing out
We’ve officially broken the $758 swing low on the daily time frame, which is not ideal. We’ve been covering this zone for the past couple of weeks, and it was a very important level short term.
There’s a chance price bounces from here and sweeps back up to all-time highs much sooner than I’m expecting. Historically, though, that only happens about 20% to 25% of the time, so I’m not banking on it.
Now that support has broken, if price can’t get back above $760 within the next week, it will most likely keep redistributing down toward $740, the lower smart money zone on the daily.
My biggest concern right now is that the monthly BX trender closed red.
When we switch over to the monthly chart, you’ll notice that over the past decade, a red monthly BX trender doesn’t necessarily mean a total market crash. (image 2)
Normally, it means a continued correction of about 5% from where we are.
The most extensive pullback was January 2022 to October 2022, when the market went into a full bear market for multiple months before finding a potential bottom. Before that, there was 2020, where the market dropped about 26% because of COVID, and a correction in 2018, where it dropped about 12%.
So looking at the past decade, a red monthly BX trender doesn’t necessarily mean the market is going to crash. It does tend to mean that the broader buying pressure is getting sucked out.
The last two times this happened were March 2026 and April 2025. Both times, we saw a continued sell-off for about a month, followed by a V-shaped recovery.
This doesn’t mean we need to go into panic mode. But like I said at the start of this analysis, a continued pullback of 2% to 3% is very much on the table.
Looking back at the decade before that, from 2000 to 2011, there were multiple monthly BX flips. (image 3)
Most of the time, like in 2005 and 2006, price just kept working its way up. But three major pullbacks happened during that decade. The first was the dot-com bubble, when the market dropped about 44% after the monthly BX turned red. Then came the 2008 financial crisis, when the market dropped about 53% after the monthly BX turned red.
I don’t want you to be worried. A red monthly BX doesn’t mean the market is going to crash. That only happens about 30% of the time when the monthly BX turns red.
What we do need to understand is that if the market is going to crash, it will happen during a red monthly BX trender. So when the BX trender is red, we need to be more careful than we are in a bull cycle.
That doesn’t mean we trade any differently. We still focus on smart money zones, and we still focus on quality setups. But there’s no reason to over-leverage positions or load up on call options. When this happens, a higher level of caution comes into my plan.
So with all that said, where does this leave us?
The most important thing to remember is that structure matters more than the cycle or the monthly BX. In every case we talked about where the market bounced after the monthly BX turned red, structure held. In every case where the market went into a serious downturn, structure gave out. So as long as structure holds, I see a low chance of a major 10% to 15% correction in the S&P 500.
On the daily chart right now, there’s a good chance we get another 2% pullback down to about $740. That would be a strong short-term area, and it’s normally where we’d see price bounce. If you use the 33 fair value band on the weekly time frame, that’s a major support too.
If $728 breaks, that’s where we get into serious correction territory. From there, I’d look for a sell-off into the weekly institutional buy zone at $684 to $660, with the smart money zone between $660 and $650. That would fill the downside gap from April 2026.
Like I said, I wouldn’t worry about that yet, because we’re still showing structure on all the smaller time frames. If the smaller time frames start to give out, that’s when we need to be aware that a broader correction could happen.

突发：2026 年第三季度韩国经济环比增长 1.0%，连续第三个季度扩张，超出 0.8% 的预期。
出口是主要驱动力，在半导体、机械和电气设备出货增强的带动下增长 2.3%。

韩国正在经历一场历史性的经济转型。

原文：BREAKING: South Korea’s economy grew +1.0% QoQ in Q3 2026, marking its 3rd consecutive quarterly expansion, beating expectations of +0.8%.
Exports were the main driver, rising +2.3% on stronger semiconductor, machinery and electrical equipment shipments.
Facility investment surged +4.1%, particularly reflecting increased spending on machinery, including semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
YoY, South Korea's economy grew +3.4%, exceeding expectations of +3.0% and following +3.7% and +3.8% growth in Q2 and Q3, respectively.
South Korea is now on track to surpass $1 trillion in annual exports for the first time in 2026, making it only the 4th economy after the US, China, and Germany to reach this threshold.
South Korea is seeing a historic economic transformation.

AI 投资与算力

The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)

AI 正在烧掉大型科技公司的自由现金流：
2026 年第三季度，亚马逊（$AMZN）、Alphabet（$GOOGL）、Meta（$META）和微软（$MSFT）的资本开支合计增加 369 亿美元，达到创纪录的 2019 亿美元。
这一数字在过去 12 个月内翻了一倍多，自 2024 年第一季度以来增长了 356%。
过去 3 年，大型科技公司在资本开支上已累计投入 1.6 万亿美元。
与此同时，这些公司上季度的自由现金流合计减少 331 亿美元，降至 -264 亿美元，为有记录以来最低。
过去一年，这些公司的自由现金流下降了 882 亿美元。
第三季度只有微软录得正的自由现金流。
展望未来，这 4 家公司计划在第四季度再投入 2320 亿美元资本开支，可能使 2026 年合计资本开支达到创纪录的 7400 亿美元。
大型科技公司正在进行史上规模最大的基础设施建设之一。
